text_block_list.name: Both of Them
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Out of my way!
—Your era is over!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—!
I will—...not sink!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The era remains firmly in her grasp...!!
The victor is Orfevre!!
She shows the sheer grit of a Classic Triple Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, phew...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh,
haha... Ha-ha-ha...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
—I grant you my pardon!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A royal pardon.
I hereby forgive all of your past insolence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Shout.
—Call out the name of your king!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! Orfevre!
Orfevre! Orfevre!
Orfevre! Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With thunderous applause at her back,
Orfevre lets her hair trail in the wind...
Seeing that sight stirred up a mix of emotions, and without thinking—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――...Why do you shed tears?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Starting from that day we first met...
When achieving the Classic Triple Crown,
and when proving our strength at the Arima Kinen—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Through all the eventful days, even in her defeat
at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...
Orfevre never stopped shining."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's strength, continuing to shine golden
no matter what happens...
I just love it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: So it was you all along.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
All has been decided.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Stop crying already.
It's unsightly.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Even on the day of your triumphant return, you intend to make a disgraceful spectacle of yourself before the people?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"There is still time.
—Together, let us make our preparations."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre! Orfevre!
Orfevre! Orfevre!
Orfevre! Orfe—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Chikichi takes the cake, no doubt.
Orfe... Damn it, she's totally my type.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Guess it's time to turn it into bouillon. Ain't no way we're missin' out while it's in season, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back... there was an Umamusume
waiting for Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —I have come to receive you, my Lord.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...They seem to be joking around.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dead serious,
stubborn-as-a-mule set meal, comin' right up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And with that! Great job in the Japan Cup, folks!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. Is that it? Are we goin' for a Japanese vibe for the after-party?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Takoyaki, okonomiyaki,
negiyaki, meat buns... There's so much to choose from."
choice_data_list: (Wait, aren't all of these flour-based dishes?)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm in the mood for French food.
And authentic stuff, at that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see. So thou art saying thou desirest a passage permit to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Show you what I got!
Well, I still gotta simmer it a bit more, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I take the King...
Golshi-chan might jump straight to the Coronation March! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And with that, see ya at the Arima Kinen! You're gonna show me some mercy, right? If you try to run away...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna stuff your shoes full of herbs.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aight,
I'll be waitin' for ya~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—I ain't giving up the title
of Best of McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know why Mejiro McQueen's
name suddenly came up, but things have
taken quite an incredible turn.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Next after the Triple Tiara is...
the Double Crown Champion, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Winning both the Satsuki Sho and Kikuka Sho this year, Gold Ship brilliantly achieved the Double Crown. She is currently on the hottest streak in the Classic division.
choice_data_list: What should we do about the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has tackled fierce races back-to-back with the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe and Japan Cup.
Taking a rest here is an option, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...How troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It's a crown I've already claimed.
I couldn't care less about it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...No, either is fine.
How do you see it?"
choice_data_list: ...If I can beat Gold Ship too, it'll be perfect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre had already defeated the strong rivals of her generation
and the Senior class, and today she fended off the younger generation.
If that's the case, then from here on—
choice_data_list: I want to establish an absolute monarchy that never rises or falls!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Not bad.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"You are to support me thoroughly.
Eliminate every concern and prepare everything to perfection."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Think you can do it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the culmination of a year full of eventful twists and turns—
as champion, advancing to the "Arima Kinen."
What lies ahead in that future is...—
choice_data_list: (It's okay. Together, Orfe and I can do this!)
(It's okay. Together, Orfe and I can do this!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That night.
The dream... revealed nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dreams that seemed to foretell the future
never came to me again.
